title: Anna NDE 4921
content: I was standing in the hallway of my house and started to see little black dots that gradually closed in my field of vision until my heart stopped and I stopped breathing. There was a sudden break in reality and my mind began to dream. I have always been a skeptical person and look for an explanation, for this reason I say that I dreamt. I know that the mind continues to function after death. There was a very intense light; I guess it was due to the dilation of my pupils. I dreamt of a place filled with people that I did not know, although I felt that I had a connection to them. Without speaking, they communicated information, images and strange theories. Dreams are always difficult to understand. I found myself in an incredible state of peace and relaxation. I wanted to stay there with those people that I did not know, but suddenly I found myself in front of a woman that I found familiar but I have not been able to recognize her. She had an authoritative yet sweet way about her. She was the only person that spoke to me using her mouth and gestures. She told me that I could not be there. I soon started to hear distant screaming. I begged to stay in that place but she did not allow me and showed me a path. Soon the screams became louder and closer until I awoke on the floor surrounded by family and nurses. I have never told anyone, including my father who asks me why I said, 'Leave me here, I am very comfortable, please.' I have always been embarrassed or afraid of rejection for telling this story. They have done many medical tests that I do not understand, many wires on my body and heart. They were never able to explain that sudden death. I guess it was just a sudden death episode and nothing else.

arrival.other_being_detail: A familiar but unrecognized woman who was 'authoritative yet sweet' and told the experiencer she could not be there, showing a path.

environment.environment_other_detail: A place 'filled with people' the experiencer did not know; also reported 'a very intense light.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return coincided with hearing distant screaming that became louder and then awakening on the floor.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden episode where vision filled with black dots, then heart stopped and stopped breathing; later described as 'sudden death episode' with no medical explanation.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described hearing screaming that grew louder before awakening; described the experience as a dream due to skepticism.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Vision loss/heart stopping -> 'break in reality' and dream -> intense light and place with many unknown people communicating without speaking -> familiar woman speaks and says she cannot be there, shows a path -> screams grow louder -> awakens on floor with family and nurses.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experiencer repeatedly frames the NDE as a dream and offers physiological explanations (pupil dilation; mind functioning after death).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There was a sudden break in reality and my mind began to dream.”; “I found myself in an incredible state of peace and relaxation.”; “She told me that I could not be there.”; “Leave me here, I am very comfortable, please.”
